verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Chroma can be run locally or self-hosted under Apache 2.0, or deployed single-tenant via BYOC in your own VPC, so users control where their data lives and how long it is kept. However, nothing in the pack documents a delete API, retention policies, TTLs, or Cloud data-deletion guarantees, so this support is only implied by deployment control. missing for 10: documented record/collection deletion operations, configurable retention or TTL policies, Chroma Cloud data-deletion and retention commitments, independent or hands-on corroboration.
